Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this humdinger of a contest. Pakistan Under-19 head into the semi finals. The ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup action continues as India Under-19 will take on South Africa Under-19 on Tuesday, the 6th of February. The game will begin at  1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT), but do join us for the early build up as well. Until then, take care, and cheers!

Saad Baig the skipper of Pakistan Under-19 says that he is thankful for this win. He says that he is happy with the performance of his side and he believes in his bowlers. Ends by saying that they have a good team and they will keep on doing their best.

Mahfuzur Rahman the skipper of Bangladesh Under-19 says that it is very tough for them to take this defeat. He says that they were happy to restrict Pakistan Under-19 to such a low score but they just fell short while chasing. Ends by saying that they are overall happy with their performance in the tournament but today was just not their day.

Ubaid Shah is the player of the match for his five-fer. He says that he is thankful that they won. Adds that they kept it calm and kept on attacking the batters. Says that after he dropped the catch he said to himself that he has to do something for his side and keep on attacking the batters. Ends by saying that they are happy to be in the semis and they will give their best in the next games.
Presentations coming up...

Earlier in the match, the Pakistan Under-19 team struggled to build partnerships and lost wickets consistently, leading to a low total of 155 runs. Bangladesh Under-19 bowlers performed well, particularly Sheikh Paevez Jibon and Md Rohanat Doullah Borson, who took four wickets each. Bangladesh needed to chase the target in 38.1 overs or less to advance to the semi-finals.

Bangladesh Under-19 will be upset with their performance, saying that they had the game under their control but failed to get over the line. They kept losing wickets at timely intervals, and that is what cost them the game. Md Rohanat Doullah Borson showed some grit in the end but unfortunately couldn't get his side over the line.

Having to defend a below-par score of 155 runs, they always needed wickets, and boy did they not put up a dominating show here! They kept taking wickets at regular intervals. They fumbled a bit with their fielding, but there were some excellent catches as well in the game. Ubaid Shah was the pick of the bowlers for them as he picked up a five-fer. Ali Raza picked three wickets whilst Mohammad Zeeshan picked up the last and only wicket of Maruf Mridha to end the game and win it for their side by just 5 runs!

PAKISTAN UNDER-19 ARE IN THE SEMIS! What a game of cricket we have witnessed here at Willowmoore Park, Benoni! The momentum of the game shifted from one corner to another, and in the end, it was Pakistan Under-19 who made their way into the semis. Credits to Bangladesh Under-19, as they put up a tough fight here but just missed the line.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Pakistan Under-19 are into the semis! This is touch short and just outside off, Maruf Mridha looks to play at it but gets a bottom edge as the ball hits the stumps! Pakistan Under-19 beat Bangladesh Under-19 by 5 runs!

Commentary.Commentary: Just short. On a length and around off. Jishan Alam reaches for it and the ball nicks the outer edge. It lands short of the fielder at slip and the batters run a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Ahmad Hassan to Jishan Alam, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off this time, Alam eases it to the third man region.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Ahmad Hassan to Jishan Alam, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Lands it on off, Alam blocks it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Ahmad Hassan to Jishan Alam, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! POWERFUL! Full and on off. Jishan Alam slaps it over the bowlers head and the ball is hit well. It runs away to the fence for four runs.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Ahmad Hassan to Jishan Alam, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Ahmad Hassan to bowl from the opposite end.
Full and outside off. Jishan Alam throws his arms at it and the ball nicks the upper edge and runs away to third man for another single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Ubaid Shah to Jishan Alam, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli pats it on the on side and runs a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Ubaid Shah to Ashiqur Rahman Shibli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A bit short and outside off. Jishan Alam slaps it towards deep point and gets off the mark with a single as well.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Ubaid Shah to Jishan Alam, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around off. Jishan Alam shoulders arms and leaves it alone for the keeper to collect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Ubaid Shah to Jishan Alam, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Halt! Ubaid Shah is uncomfortable while landing his feet because the foot holes are uneven. The groundstaff is called with a hammer and it is time to flatten them so the bowler can continue his rhythm.
Short and around off. Jishan Alam slaps it but gets it off the toe end of his bat. The ball lands behind the umpires and lands safely.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Ubaid Shah to Jishan Alam, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: No, again a bad line. Short and again wide outside off. Jishan Alam tries to cut it but the ball is out of his reach. The umpire signals a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Ubaid Shah to Jishan Alam, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Errs in line again. Goes full and wide outside off this time. Jishan Alam shoulders arms. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Ubaid Shah to Jishan Alam, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: Off the mark! Ubaid Shah delivers it on a full length and on off. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli gets the inner edge and the ball rolls away towards square leg. The batters sneak in a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Ubaid Shah to Ashiqur Rahman Shibli, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Starts off with a poor line. Bowls it short and going down the leg side. Ashiqur Rahman Shibli shoulders arms and the umpire signals a wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Ubaid Shah to Ashiqur Rahman Shibli, Wide!
